title: HD terrain texture overlay (VanillaHD community textures)
description: Packs 671 community terrain textures into Data/patch-1.MPQ (below the official patches). The textures are NOT from your WoW install: you obtain the pinned files yourself (see the source instructions) and the installer verifies every byte against the hashes recorded here.

vanillahd.instructions: Get the pinned community files into one folder laid out as <folder>/Patch-B/<path> (VanillaHD/Patch-B at commit a112a137f3183d53cdd4e88c94f9c81fbeaa294a). Easiest: python tools/fetch_community_sources.py --recipe hd-terrain-community --dest <folder> --yes (an explicit, separate download of only these hash-pinned files). Then pass --source vanillahd=<folder>. Review the repositories' licenses before use; the installer never redistributes these files.

provenance.note: pinned community textures; not latest-retail proof. The live patch-1.MPQ stores the same 671 files uncompressed; the installer's packer compresses, so the archive bytes differ but every file is byte-identical.
